correctness.rationale: The 5x5 transition matrix for forbidding five cyclic zeros correctly represents all cyclic dominating strings, and trace(M^n), (M^j)00(M^(n-j))00 give exact first and second moments, including j=0. Affine positivity follows from all-ones and n single-zero words. Primitive Perron renewal has gap distribution t^1,...,t^5. Independent high-precision calculation found t=0.508660391642004, derivative roots -0.829814520866, -0.353446566629, 0.218869616452, global-max/min ratio 1.4795808166652. The RESULT.md gives an exact rational Descartes-sign/root isolation argument; numeric reproduction is corroboration, not alone proof of root completeness.
